policy.managed_club_resolution: managed_clubs() UID; owned club team slot 0
policy.player_profiles: managed first-team only; no reserve/youth or opponent profiles
policy.player_match_stats: managed first-team roster and historical guests with actual first-team minutes
policy.player_season_stats: tracked players, managed first-team team_id rows only
policy.selections: managed first-team starters and substitutes only
policy.fixtures: all matches involving managed first team; opponent identity, date, competition, venue and score retained
policy.team_match_stats: both home and away team rows for each match involving managed first team
policy.opponent_data: opponent team-level statistics only in direct matches; no opponent player data or unrelated matches
policy.tactics: not exported, decoded, inferred or reconstructed; user supplies match-to-tactic mapping

notes: No fixed club UID or team ID is embedded; identity is resolved from the save at runtime.
Every retained team match must have exactly one home and one away team row.
Opponent team statistics are retained only for matches involving the managed first team.
Opponent player records and unrelated opponent matches are excluded.
Tactical configurations are not exported or inferred; user supplies the tactic used in each match.
